# Cadenza London Music Academy

> Cadenza London Music Academy offers 1-on-1 piano, violin, music theory and aural lessons with Eric Chung, in person in Colindale, North West London (NW9), UK, and online worldwide. It prepares children and adults for ABRSM and Trinity College London grades 1–8 (face-to-face and digital/recorded exams) and for performance diplomas: Trinity ATCL, LTCL and FTCL, and ABRSM ARSM, DipABRSM and LRSM. Lessons are in English or Cantonese.

Key facts:
- Teacher: Eric Chung, pianist and violinist. Master of Music, Royal Conservatoire of Antwerp; trained in Classical Piano Performance and Violin Performance at The Hong Kong Academy for Performing Arts. 16+ years teaching.
- Results: 100% passing rate; 200+ students achieved Merit or Distinction.
- Online lessons: live 1-on-1 video lessons, available worldwide, scheduled Monday to Saturday on UK time. Lessons from £35; diploma-level lessons £80 per 60 minutes.
- Online diploma preparation: programme selection, step-by-step learning of each piece, exam-standard mock exams and guidance on recording digital diploma submissions. Suitable for adults returning to the piano.
- Online Coaching (video feedback): send a video of your exam piece and receive exam-style marking with written and video feedback. Single Piece Check from £15 (Grades 1–4) to £35 (Diploma); Full Exam Check from £49 (Grades 1–4) to £129 (Diploma).
- Digital Exam Ready Course: 4-week in-person course in London for ABRSM and Trinity digital exams, Grades 1–8, ending with the exam video recorded on a grand piano. From £295.
- Sight-Reading Club: weekly online piano sight-reading group on Zoom, Tuesdays 6pm UK time, Grades 1–8.
- Contact: music@cadenza-london.com, +44 7572 010370. Trial lessons: https://cadenza-london.com/booking/
